existing_system_baseline: The existing ML Serve API path remains the system under test: control API, file-ledger queue, supervised lifecycle worker and observer, Airflow, MLflow, model serving, Prometheus, and the local OpenTelemetry Collector.

architecture_delta.before: The existing runtime emitted partial telemetry, retained exact run or intent identifiers in Prometheus discovery labels, treated an intentionally inactive B0 deployment as an always-on scrape target, and had no real Spark boundary in the lifecycle data DAG.
architecture_delta.after: The same runtime now has bounded API and model-serving metric labels, endpoint-bound Prometheus verification, desired-replica-aware B0 target discovery, and a bounded real local Spark stage in the existing Airflow data path. Runtime rollout and cross-runtime acceptance remain pending.

changed_existing_boundaries.before: Route-level API latency was incomplete and scenario serving used exact run and artifact identity as Prometheus labels.
changed_existing_boundaries.after: HTTP metrics use bounded method, route-template, status-class, model-family, environment, and target-slot dimensions; exact identity remains in readiness and trace attributes.

changed_existing_boundaries.before: The B0 NodePort was statically scraped even when its Deployment was intentionally scaled to zero.
changed_existing_boundaries.after: The existing Kubernetes observer publishes the B0 target only when desired replicas are greater than zero and preserves the last target state when cluster observation itself fails.

changed_existing_boundaries.before: The lifecycle DAG did not cross a Spark runtime boundary.
changed_existing_boundaries.after: A bounded local Spark probe is inserted after the lakehouse probe. It proves only local runtime continuity; distributed executor, shuffle, spill, skew, and scale remain S5.

failure_and_rca.failure: The first focused test invocation could not collect FastAPI TestClient tests.
failure_and_rca.root_cause: The documented local test runtime did not declare or contain the TestClient HTTP dependency.
failure_and_rca.correction: A pinned test extra was added and the dependency was installed in the existing test runtime.
failure_and_rca.retest: The focused suite passed 61 tests and the complete suite passed 588 tests.

failure_and_rca.failure: A wildcard file-discovery pattern would have scraped the B0 target through both the B0 and lifecycle jobs.
failure_and_rca.root_cause: Both target classes shared one directory and the lifecycle job accepted every JSON file.
failure_and_rca.correction: Each Prometheus job now reads its exact target file.
failure_and_rca.retest: Prometheus configuration validation passed; live reload awaits the runtime checkpoint.

unresolved: The changed API, Airflow, Prometheus, observer, worker, and model-serving runtimes have not yet been rebuilt and revision-aligned.
The local Spark stage has contract tests but has not yet executed in the rebuilt Airflow runtime.
No fresh trace has yet linked API, queue, worker, Airflow, data, Spark, MLflow, and serving.
The bounded metric closure and three independent low-load controls have not yet been captured or hashed.
private_evidence: Raw traces and future control measurements remain outside Git. They cannot satisfy acceptance until sealed by digest and linked from the public evidence index.
claim_boundary: This proves an in-place telemetry implementation and regression checkpoint only. It is not S0 runtime acceptance, scale, availability, Spark distribution, or production evidence.
